sections.title: Consolidation Goals
items: I can open a story, sequence its events, mark its turning point and close it.
I can use miután and mielőtt correctly, alone and combined, with past tense in both clauses.
I can use the full set of scene-setting, sequencing and closing words from this unit.
I can tell a short, well-structured story of my own about something that happened to me.
